data.value: Rona likarretso tsa Windows ka ViVeTool. Opatshe kapa opikisa likarretso tse hlakileng tsa Windows.

Fumana pondo ea ho hlahloba pele. Rona lihlooho tse hlakileng feela. Mehlala e mengata e hloka ho tsamaisa peletse kapa e ka fetolela haholo ntle le tlhokomelo (backup).
